display_long_description:
Archery Expert is an immersive archery game designed for Meta Quest, focused on AR and VR archery practice with difficulty-based level play. Real-time arrow physics make drawing the bow, aiming, shooting, and hitting targets feel natural, clear, and satisfying.

In AR mode, you can turn your room into a personal shooting range or step outdoors for more realistic target practice. Shoot static targets, moving ground targets, and flying targets as bows, arrows, and targets blend into your real environment for strong mixed reality presence.

In VR mode, you can enter different virtual environments and practice freely without physical space limits. It is suitable for relaxed training, warm-up sessions, accuracy practice, and players who want a simple but responsive archery experience.

Future versions will also add multiplayer, allowing players to compete in archery matches in the same AR or VR environment.

Key Features:
- 🎯 AR and VR game modes
- 🏠 Mixed reality archery in real spaces
- 🌐 Archery practice in virtual environments
- 🕹️ Realistic arrow physics and intuitive controls
- 🧘 Relaxing practice, warm-up, and accuracy training
- ⚡ Lightweight practice plus difficulty-based challenges
- 🥽 Designed for Meta Quest controllers

The current free version mainly provides practice mode for players who want to experience MR/VR archery. The paid version will add Challenge Mode and a complete new VR scene with more targets, richer levels, and advanced gameplay challenges.
